$comment: Front matter for Genesys Cloud CX Lab lessons. Lesson bodies stay in campus/data/tracks/*.json. data/lesson-map.json is the checked front matter. scripts/validate_lessons.mjs exits 1 on any problem.

properties.key: string, '<track id>/<lesson id>', must match campus/data/tracks
properties.title: string, must equal the lesson title
properties.level: integer 0-10. Foundation is 0, Core is 4, Advanced is 8. A recommendation, never a lock.
properties.minutes: integer, as in the lesson file
properties.outcomes: array of at least one phrase from the lesson summary
properties.sources: array of at least one id that exists as campus/data/sources/<id>.json
properties.has_exercise: boolean, true when the lesson has a lab checklist
properties.last_verified: null or YYYY-MM-DD. Null means the source file only records a month (YYYY-MM), not a full day.
